## How to Get Started

1. Visit [Google Drive](https://drive.google.com/)
2. Log in with your free Google Account
3. Open the [HVAC drawing template](https://docs.google.com/drawings/d/1vvLk-M1lQ0yWa-6xaNm6Qloj_LGAEF75T5g5AU_QtVk/edit?usp=sharing)
4. Click 'File > Make a copy' to create your own version
5. Start building your HVAC diagram

## Key Benefits

- **No Installation**: Works entirely in your web browser
- **Free to Use**: Completely free Google Drive tools
- **Easy Sharing**: Collaborate with team members in real-time
- **Professional Templates**: Pre-built HVAC components and symbols
- **Export & Publish**: Share diagrams publicly or privately
- **Integration**: Combine with Google Docs and Spreadsheets
